text:
tara: Follow-up from this morning's streaming flake. We had ~38 partial responses and several handshake timeouts concentrated on the chat endpoint.
sam: saw truncated chunks then reconnects. collecting traces and client logs.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0429-stream-flare created. Severity: P2.
maria: short timeline: 08:49 first timeout spike -> 08:51 partials surge -> 09:05 gradual recovery. No prod deploys recorded.
jon: likely cause: KV eviction spikes with long-context traffic burst. will run repro.
tara: proposed remediation and owners:
  1) client backoff bump (owner: sam) — increase handshake backoff 5s->10s for high-priority routes; staging tests then 24h monitor. target: 2026-05-02
  2) partial-response alert (owner: maria) — metric + dashboard + PagerDuty rule at 0.3% over 10m. target: 2026-05-04
  3) KV eviction repro + profiles (owner: jon) — load generator, heap/GC capture. target: 2026-05-07
  4) gated retries on gateway + circuit-breaker (owners: sam+maria) — cap retries, CB watches CPU and queue depth. target: 2026-05-06
  5) 90-day recurrence analysis (owner: maria) — group by signature, link historical owners. target: 2026-05-08
sam: I'll take #1 and validate in staging. note: we must measure backend queueing impact before prod.
maria: will add the alert and dashboard tile; will run the 90d recurrence scan after that and post results.
jon: repro plan: 250 concurrent streams, mix short/long prefixes, force KV churn. will capture profiles and drop into runbook.
tara: small temporary mitigation: lower batch sizes for long-context canary route to reduce KV pressure; I'll prototype this.
sam: caution on retries — they can amplify load. staging validation is required.
incident-bot: Actions assigned: #1 sam, #2 maria, #3 jon, #4 sam+maria, #5 maria.
tara: scheduling a follow-up sync Thursday 09:30 PT to review progress. If you hit regressions before then ping @sam and @maria.
sam: :thumbsup:
maria: will post dashboards when ready.
jon: kicking off repro now and will post artifacts.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0429 status -> monitoring.
